 Wie zoeken we?

 Wat bieden wij je?

How is the salary calculated? 
The basic hourly wage is €16.06. 
You will receive a 120% bonus for all hours worked, whether you work early, late, or night shifts. €16.06 x 120% = €19.27. 
On top of that, you will also receive €0.91 in ADV per hour worked: €19.27 + €0.91 = €20.18 gross per hour.
